labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected deadlock behaviour with redirected stdout/stderr in Live.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable reproduction; check_report found runnable_example false.

items.body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. To look into the deadlock, a maintainer needs a minimal runnable example that reproduces it: a short script that uses `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)` and has a second thread or task printing or logging while the display refreshes. Please also paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`, since the report lists only the Rich version and platform.

Related earlier reports: #927 (deadlock on exiting `Status`, with a similar lock analysis) and #3125 (redirected output with `Live`).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
